slot.brief: Sentence with a compound subject joined by 'as well as' or a collective noun where the verb is misused; student must spot the agreement error in one part.

stem:
Identify the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The committee have agreed to publish its findings after the final review is completed.

verdicts.working: In standard American English, “committee” is singular, so it takes “has agreed”; the error is in (A). British English may allow a plural verb with a collective noun, making the wording dialect-dependent.
issues: Dialect is unspecified; plural agreement with collective nouns such as “committee” is acceptable in some varieties of English.

working:
“Committee” is a collective noun treated as a single unit here, as shown by the singular pronoun “its”; use “has agreed.” The other parts are grammatically correct.
